 Home » Companies » Mars names new VP of snacking division Mars names new VP of snacking division
 João Belo has been named global vice president of corporate affairs for Mars Snacking, effective January 4, 2027. 
 | Source: MARS, ©ALEXSANDR MATVEEV – STOCK.ADOBE.COM 
 Nov 16, 2026 
 By Zachary Sosland 
 Add as a preferred
source on Google MCLEAN, VA. — Mars, Inc. has named João Belo global vice president of corporate affairs for Mars Snacking, effective January 4, 2027. Belo will report to global president of Mars, Andrew Clarke, and sit on the company’s snacking leadership team and global corporate affairs leadership team.
 In his new role, Belo will lead the Mars Snacking corporate affairs and oversee global communications, public affairs and the community impact agenda.
 According to Mars, Belo brings more than 30 years of corporate affairs experience to the company, having worked in various markets including the United States, Europe and Japan. He was previously chief communications officer of American healthcare company Danaher Corp. where he led global communications, philanthropy and community impact initiatives in addition to driving brand preference and integrating generative AI. He also was senior VP of global communications at Takeda Pharmaceuticals, leading comprehensive digital and communications transformation.
 “I couldn't be happier to welcome João to Mars Snacking,” said Andrew Clarke, global president of Mars Snacking. “As we build a truly global snacking business, João's wealth of experience will not only benefit our ambitious growth agenda but also further our efforts to grow in a responsible way that supports our Associates, partners, and the communities where we operate – while continuing to build consumer trust.”
